comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
Eh, in case you get sunk while shipwrecking, or a storm sweeps some of your sailors away while you're headed to a wreck site...? It'd be nice if they fixed Rescue skill so it would work when doing salvage work too, but other than fixing your own ship in the event of some weird emergency (like being ambushed and sunk before you can use tributes), it doesn't help as much as it could.

Still not as weird/useless as Chef job's favoring Observe, though!
